items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: So when we’d go into a studio Bernard Purdie would set up all these music stands

ctx.x: So when we’d go into a studio Bernard Purdie would set up all these music stands and he’d have these signs that he used to carry around “Bernard Purdie Hit Maker” and all kinds — you know like he would just stack them up. So that was his ego showing but you know what, he backed it up with music. He was a really fine drummer. You couldn’t — his ego was worth every cent of it.
I imagine he would sort of butt heads with the producer on occasion, because he knew what was needed?
